_help: Story map: the player's route through the whole island, read by game/map/island_miniature.tscn (the 3D miniature). Edit the numbers, save, and re-run the miniature to see the change. Coordinates are the game's world metres: x = east, z = south (north/up the mountain is NEGATIVE z), y = height above sea level. Route points (a stage's last point is the next stage's first): [x, z] = on the ground (height taken from the terrain); [x, z, y] = at that exact height (underground or in the air). status: built = a level scene exists; proposed = designed for Ch5-Ch6, or a PROPOSED insert (the jungle loop S01a-S01d and the hamlet detour S03a, not yet in any chapter). Terrain beyond the built levels (west coast, summit, north coast) is in game/map/island_height.gd.

stages.name: Beach
stages.note: The captain drops you. The Black Stone (the Sleeper's spire) sits out past the point. PROPOSED CHANGE (jungle loop): the trail mouth is blocked, so you leave the beach to the WEST along the shore (the built Ch1 beach leads straight to the trail).

stages.name: Shore and river ford
stages.note: The trail mouth is shut by a jackknifed truck and a rockfall (roadblock 1, with a 'DET 9: ROAD CLOSED' stencil). The only way on is west along the shore to the river mouth and across the ford.

stages.name: Jungle and first roadblock
stages.note: Dense jungle on the west plateau, 15 m above the trail, kept south of the ravine. Tyre ruts, offerings tied to trees, a bend that doubles back. It ends at the west end of an old military road: a barricade and a rusted jeep.

stages.name: The old road: bridge convoy
stages.note: The road crosses the river on a half-collapsed bridge with a convoy stuck on it: old trucks from different decades (roadblock 2), the way back over the water. It ends at a boom gate and guard hut at the rim (roadblock 3).

stages.name: The rim overlook and the gully
stages.note: From the rim you look down on the trail, with the ravine ahead and the lit harbor beyond it, and up at the mountain. A footpath along the rim, then a gully down into the trail.

stages.name: Trail
stages.note: Fallen tree, ruined wall, three-hollow shrine with Elias's warning. PROPOSED (jungle loop): now entered from the gully (S01d), not from the beach.

stages.name: Ravine
stages.note: Scaffold collapses behind you: the way back to the beach is gone.

stages.name: The cut road and the old hamlet
stages.note: After the ravine a landslide has cut the road. A worn path climbs the west wall to the ruins of the mainland fishermen's hamlet (graves, a warning board), then a track drops into the harbor yard from the west.

stages.name: Old Harbor
stages.note: Shed, watchtower, Reyes's body, Vane switching on the searchlight. Cut the gate chain as the Black Stone rises. PROPOSED (hamlet detour): now entered from the west, from the hamlet track (S03a); the built Ch1 enters from the ravine.

stages.name: Base Camp
stages.note: Vane Bio-Marine supply depot. Hide from The Shepherd in the barracks, power the substation, hear Vane's spliced 'Elias' voice on the intercom.

stages.name: The Line (cable car)
stages.note: The ride up through luminescent fog while The Shepherd races the slope. Elias's sabotage stops Car 2 at Pylon 3.

stages.name: The Fall
stages.note: A rung gives way on Pylon 3. Blackout. You wake in the unpowered Old Village hollow.

stages.name: The Old Village
stages.note: Carvings of the Sleeper, Capt. Locke's 1784 log, Vane's dig site & false radio code, the Pale Shard in the Burned Quarter. Ride the lift to the Service Path bridge, which collapses into the West Gully.

stages.name: West Gully (down to coast)
stages.note: After the Service Path bridge ambush, tumble/descend 115m down the steep gully to sea level at the West Cove. One-way.

stages.name: Wreck of HMS Madrigal
stages.note: Capt. Locke's 1784 brig wedged in the cove. Tidal gun-deck puzzle, Locke's melted iron cage, Elias's waterproof pack.

stages.name: The Sea Cave
stages.note: Entered from the surf. Locke's 1784 crew fused like living coral into the wet limestone walls.

stages.name: Smuggler's Tunnel
stages.note: Flooded timber-and-concrete tunnel. Hide in submerged water alcoves and use the Pale Shard to blind The Shepherd.

stages.name: Abyssal Caverns (Deep Chorus)
stages.note: 170m vertical climb inside the hollow mountain. Bioluminescent ledges of the Deep Chorus villagers, the Sleeper's cathedral-sized Eye in the chasm below, harmonic bridge puzzles.

stages.name: Sub-Level Bunker B (Elias)
stages.note: Find the dying real Sgt. Elias guarding Tide-Stone #3. Vane drops his disguise on the PA. Ride the 75m freight lift up to the Research Center.

stages.name: Research Center
stages.note: Top of the cable line (300m). Mara's Acoustics Lab; Vane uses the building's blast doors, lights, and halon gas against you while The Shepherd prowls.

stages.name: Neural Siphon Facility
stages.note: 360m elevation. Confront Julian Vane's half-calcified, mutating body inside the Faraday Siphon Pod. Set the Siphon Routing Console before climbing to the crater.

stages.name: The Summit: Ritual Crater
stages.note: 430m crater peak beneath the open Void Halo. Final Shepherd confrontation and the 3 Cosmic Horror Endings with Tide-Stone #3.

side_routes.name: Cable line to the upper station
side_routes.note: The cargo line runs to the Research Center's Upper Station. The Shepherd climbs this line to reach Chapter 6.

side_routes.name: Service path (A07 bridge ambush)
side_routes.note: After riding the Village Cargo Lift up, the player walks the first section of the lit path until The Shepherd smashes the Old Stream Plank Bridge, dropping them toward the West Gully.

side_routes.name: Village cargo lift (Ch4 exit)
side_routes.note: Takes the player out of the Festival Ring up to the Lit Service Path at the end of Chapter 4.

side_routes.name: The river (PROPOSED)
side_routes.note: Runs north to south across the west plateau to the south coast. Crossed twice, both south of the ravine: the ford (south) and the collapsed bridge (north).

side_routes.name: The short way (blocked)
side_routes.note: The built Ch1 beach-to-trail path. Blocked by roadblock 1 so the player must take the jungle loop.

structures.name: Roadblock 3: boom gate at the rim
